segments.text: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.
And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi,

segments.speaker: Naomi
segments.text: Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace.

segments.speaker: Naomi
segments.text: And she said unto her,
Go, my daughter.
And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
¶ And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.
Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers,

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: Whose damsel is this?
And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said,

segments.speaker: The foreman
segments.text: It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

segments.speaker: Ruth
segments.text: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.
Then said Boaz unto Ruth,

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.
Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Ruth
segments.text: Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?
And Boaz answered and said unto her,

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

segments.speaker: Ruth
segments.text: Then she said,
Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord;

segments.speaker: Ruth
segments.text: for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.
And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar.

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: And she sat beside the reapers:
and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying,

segments.speaker: Ruth got up to glean, Boaz
segments.text: Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

segments.speaker: Boaz
segments.text: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
¶ And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.
And her mother in law said unto her,

segments.speaker: Ruth
segments.text: Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou?
blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee.

segments.speaker: Ruth
segments.text: And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said,
The man’s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.
And Naomi said unto her daughter in law,

segments.speaker: Naomi
segments.text: Blessed be he of the LORD, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead.
And Naomi said unto her,

segments.speaker: Naomi
segments.text: The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

footnotes.text: + one of…: or, one that hath right to redeem

segments.text: And Ruth the Moabitess said,

segments.speaker: Ruth the Moabitess
segments.text: He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law,

segments.speaker: Naomi
segments.text: It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.
So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.
